rules.causation: An expressly unavailable causation opinion is UNCERTAIN.
rules.component: A component reference without a manufacturer or content specification is REVIEW.
rules.exposure: An exposure allegation tied only to an unspecified component is REVIEW.
rules.liability: A liability allegation without duty, breach, and causation proof is REVIEW.
rules.material: A witness belief alone cannot establish product material content; route to UNCERTAIN.
rules.product: A product is MATCH only when a product reference and a manufacturer reference share the same product ID.

synthetic_fixture_notice: All products, entities, records, and outcomes are synthetic test fixtures.
